name: Steel Acoustic Guitar — AG08 S4 Sympathetic Coupling
strengths: retains the accepted AG01 R3 note renderer, AG07 action renderer, AG08-S2 same-string continuity and AG08-S3 shared body memory
routes already-authored source-string bridge force into spectrally compatible target-string modal state without creating MIDI or Render-IR note events
allocates a bounded quadratic bridge-domain energy fraction across target strings and attenuates the source by the complementary energy factor
radiates sympathetic target-string state through the same accepted acoustic-guitar body model rather than a separate reverb, chorus or sample layer
limitations: AG08-S4 is a compact reduced-order coupling model, not a geometry/material-derived FEM or BEM guitar simulation
sympathetic compatibility uses generic standard-tuning string coordinates and near-coincident modal partials rather than measured bridge admittance
formal long-horizon passive stability closure remains AG08-S6 and multi-technique transition closure remains AG08-S5
